metadata.purpose: Five recommended plants and three agricultural crop-cycle/rotation options for each of Myanmar’s 15 first-level administrative areas.
metadata.how_to_use: Choose a crop cycle based on local rainfall, irrigation, soil test results, elevation, market access, and security conditions. Rotating cereals with pulses can improve soil fertility and reduce continuous-cropping risks.

suitability_scale.Medium: Possible with specific management or site conditions
